crossRefs.note: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you…
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
“If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not…
You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent…
You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not your brother interest, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all…

translations.web: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’
translations.bsb: Why then did you not deposit my money in the bank, and upon my return I could have collected it with interest?’
translations.kjv: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
translations.asv: then wherefore gavest thou not my money into the bank, and I at my coming should have required it with interest?
